subject: How to modify an already deployed shinyapp

messages.author: 89bf9a5ae60bbf8a
messages.subject: How to modify an already deployed shinyapp
parts:
Hi everyone!

I already deployed my first shinyapp succesfully. However I have come up with some improvements in my local version.

Is there any way I can re-deploy these new features, or the entire app? I wouldn't want to deploy a new app because I would have to change the name.

Thank you!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to modify an already deployed shinyapp
parts:
You can just run deployApp() again from the directory and it will replace your existing version with the new copy.

Best of luck,
Tareef
